docs/architecture.md:564:- **The `/mcp` endpoint exposes the same service layer to AI clients.** The 8 FastMCP tools are thin wrappers reusing the same services + per-suite authz + sample redaction as the REST API — no logic duplication. It mounts under **any** of the three sign-in modes (SSO, email OTP, dev-bypass) and stays unmounted, **fail-closed**, only when none is configured. Under SSO it validates the same OIDC bearer (Azure AD or Cognito — a `JWTVerifier` on the same tenant/audience/scope) or a PAT; **under email OTP a PAT is the only accepted credential** — a raw JWT and a session cookie are both rejected there, since there is no IdP-issued bearer to validate and a session is a browser-only credential ([#1151](https://github.com/TheurgicDuke771/DataQ/issues/1151)). See [ADR 0008](adr/0008-mcp-server.md) / [ADR 0032](adr/0032-email-otp-signin.md).
